description: Reserved by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content presents the audited balance sheet of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka along with the Auditor General's review report. It deals with financial reporting requirements, audit standards, and regulatory compliance matters for a financial institution. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it concerns regulatory frameworks, statutory financial reporting obligations, and compliance with auditing standards rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
